layer_description: This cluster groups provisions that sit above ordinary operational rules and organize the legal framework at a high level. They set overarching principles, define the scope or interpretive approach of the code, and allocate general responsibilities or default regimes, often leaving concrete implementation to subordinate or later rules.
repr_descriptions: ["Foundational principle clause that sets the overarching normative objective and interpretive benchmark for the entire code — it sits at the highest level of abstraction because it frames the governing aim and the values that must guide all later rules. It is not a technical implementation rule, but a structural standard that directs discretion and the application of more specific provisions.", "Structural, framework-level provision that articulates a governing principle and then translates it into a limited set of institutional and liability-guiding consequences. It sits above ordinary operational rules because it frames how discretion, responsibility, and organisational conduct should be understood, while still moving beyond pure abstraction by setting specific interpretive and behavioural standards.", "Foundational principle clause: it articulates a general governing standard that guides the entire framework rather than a specific operative step. It sits near the top of the abstraction spectrum because it states an overarching normative objective and only refers in general terms to implementation “according to the methods indicated by the code,” without fixing a concrete procedure or threshold.", "Foundational interpretive clause at the structural level: it does not create a concrete operative rule, but tells the reader how the entire code must be read and applied. Its function is to anchor all subsequent provisions to a set of higher-order principles, making it a general interpretive gateway rather than a technical implementation rule.", "Foundational-structural provision that sets a general governing principle and a broad default rule for the framework, rather than a narrow operational procedure. Its abstraction level is high because it establishes the baseline contractual freedom and only then carves out limited exceptions and safeguards, without prescribing a detailed implementation mechanism.", "Structural scope clause that delineates the code’s field of application, including express inclusions, exclusions, and a limited cross-reference to a separate implementing instrument. It sits at an intermediate level of abstraction because it does not set a general principle for the whole framework, but instead organizes when the framework applies and when specific procedural rules are left to a subordinate act.", "Structural provision that sets general transparency principles and coordinates how disclosure obligations are organized across the framework, rather than prescribing a single operational step. It sits above technical detail because it identifies the governing publication logic and allocates a general responsibility, while leaving the concrete implementation to other provisions and to referenced rules.", "Structural provision that sets the common governing rule for a defined class of cases, while also carving out a condition that redirects some cases to the ordinary regime. It sits above the operational level because it does not detail the mechanics of performance, but it is not foundational either, since it mainly organizes which general rules apply and when a different procedural track is triggered.", "Intermediate structural provision that delineates the scope of application of a broader set of rules and identifies which additional provisions are incorporated by reference. It also contains limited empowerment and procedural specifications for certain operators, so it sits above purely technical detail but below foundational principles because it mainly organises applicability and delegated adjustments rather than laying down the core framework.", "Structural provision with a limited coordinating and notification function: it assigns a specific institutional step to be triggered upon a report, and preserves external commitments. It sits below foundational rules and above purely technical details because it does not create a general principle or a full procedure, but rather activates a targeted mechanism within a defined scenario."]

layer_description: These provisions delimit the material or personal scope of a legal instrument by carving out specific cases, categories, or situations from the general regime. They function as technical boundary-setting rules, often through explicit exceptions, cross-references, and conditions that determine when the main framework does not apply.
repr_descriptions: ["Operational exclusion clause with a highly specific, technical function: it carves out a closed list of situations in which the general regime does not apply. Its structure is not foundational but exception-setting, because it fixes concrete conditions, categories, and thresholds that delimit the reach of the broader framework.", "This is an operational-to-technical exception clause: it does not set a general framework, but carves out a narrowly defined derogation from the ordinary rules and then attaches specific conditions for using it. Its abstraction level is low because it fixes concrete procedural safeguards, approval requirements, and oversight mechanisms for a limited category of cases.", "This is a narrow operational exclusion rule, sitting near the technical end of the hierarchy. It does not set a general principle or institutional structure; instead, it fixes a specific applicability carve-out, adds a reporting step on request, and ties the exclusion to an external listing mechanism.", "This is a highly specific operational exclusion clause, sitting near the technical end of the hierarchy. It carves out a narrow category from the general framework by stating that the code does not apply in a defined situation, without setting any broader principle or organising rule.", "Highly specific operational exclusion clause within the framework, because it carves out a closed list of situations in which the general regime does not apply. Its structure is technical and concrete: it enumerates detailed exceptions, cross-references external definitions, and fixes a particular conditional arrangement, rather than laying down a general principle or delegating rule-making power.", "Operational-to-technical exclusion clause: it does not set a broad governing principle, but carves out specific categories from the scope of this Part and points to a separate set of principles for the excluded cases. Its abstraction level is low because it functions as a scope-defining rule and cross-reference, rather than a foundational or structural norm.", "Operational exclusion clause at a relatively specific level: it carves out defined matters from the Directive’s scope rather than laying down a general principle. Its function is to delimit application by stating a negative boundary, making it a technical scope-setting rule within the broader framework.", "Operational exclusion clause at a relatively specific level: it does not set a general principle, but carves out a defined category from the Directive’s scope. Its function is structural and delimiting, because it fixes the boundary of application rather than prescribing how the regime operates within that boundary.", "Technical definitional/exclusion clause that carves out a specific category from the directive’s scope by listing examples and cross-referencing another instrument. It sits near the operational end of the spectrum because it does not state a general principle or allocate powers, but instead fixes a precise boundary for application.", "Highly specific exclusion clause at the operational/technical end of the spectrum: it carves out a defined category by cross-referencing other instruments and limiting the carve-out to matters already covered elsewhere. Its function is not to state a general principle, but to delimit the scope of the act through a precise, situation-bound exception."]

layer_description: These provisions operate at a technical level to carve out specific cases, conditions, or categories from an otherwise general rule or prohibition. Their normative role is to delimit the reach of the main rule by introducing narrowly framed exceptions, often tied to concrete factual or procedural criteria.
repr_descriptions: ["Narrow operational exception clause carving out specific situations from a general rule, so it sits near the technical end of the spectrum. Its function is to delimit the scope of an existing provision by listing concrete excluded cases, rather than laying down a broad principle or institutional framework.", "Narrow operational exception clause within a broader rule, carving out a specific category of requirements that remain permissible only in defined circumstances. It sits toward the technical end of the spectrum because it does not set a general principle or framework; instead, it specifies a concrete condition limiting when a particular administrative formality may be imposed.", "Narrow operational exception within a broader rule, sitting near the technical end of the spectrum. It does not establish a general principle or structure; instead, it carves out one specific contractual scenario and identifies a concrete condition that limits the rule’s application.", "Narrow operational exception clause within a broader prohibition, carving out one specific category of requirements by reference to a defined justification. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish a general principle or institutional power, but instead fine-tunes the scope of an existing rule through a precise carve-out.", "Narrow operational exception clause within a broader rule, because it sets one specific condition that must be satisfied for a particular derogation to apply. Its abstraction level is low: it does not establish a general principle, but instead fixes a concrete comparative criterion for use in a defined decision-making context.", "Narrow operational exception clause that carves out a specific category of providers and ties the rule to a justification test. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not state a general principle, but instead specifies a conditional limitation applicable only where independence and impartiality need to be secured.", "Narrow operational exception clause within a broader procedural framework, carving out a specific category of cases from the general rule. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish a general principle or institutional power, but instead identifies a precise situation and attaches a tailored procedural treatment to it.", "Highly specific operational exception clause, carving out a narrow procedural scenario from the general regime. Its abstraction level is low because it does not establish a general principle or delegation, but instead identifies a concrete condition tied to a particular award procedure and its mandatory application.", "Highly specific operational exception clause, carving out a narrow category of cases from the general rule by reference to a concrete factual setting. Its abstraction level is low because it does not lay down a general principle or framework, but instead fixes a precise situational condition that determines when the rule does not apply.", "Narrow operational exception clause that carves out a specific condition from a broader rule, sitting near the technical end of the spectrum. Its defining feature is that it fixes a concrete applicability test—requiring a tangible indication and high probability of future proceedings, plus advice from a qualified lawyer—rather than laying down a general principle or structural competence."]

layer_description: These provisions operate at a low, concrete level in the hierarchy, translating higher-level principles into detailed operative steps. They typically regulate how a specific procedure is carried out, including conditions, sequences, deadlines, roles, communication methods, and remedial or evidentiary mechanisms.
repr_descriptions: ["Operational provision with a strong technical character: it translates a general principle into concrete duties for contracting authorities and economic operators, and then sets out the specific compliance steps to follow. Its abstraction level is low because it fixes detailed conditions, verification mechanisms, and remedial payment procedures for a defined implementation scenario.", "Operational provision with a strong technical character: it lays down the concrete appointment, designation, and role-allocation rules for a specific internal function within the procedure. Its abstraction level is low because it does not set a general principle for the whole framework, but instead specifies who is appointed, when, by whom, and with what procedural consequences and exceptions.", "Operational provision with a strong technical character: it lays down the step-by-step sequence and conditions for moving through a specific decision-making procedure, rather than stating a broad governing principle. Its abstraction level is low because it fixes concrete acts, deadlines, effects, exceptions, and procedural consequences, making it a detailed implementation rule within a larger framework.", "Operational provision that sets the default channel and hierarchy for how communications must be carried out within the framework. It is specific because it prescribes the concrete method to be used, with a fallback sequence and cross-reference to another code, rather than laying down a general principle or delegating further rule-making.", "Operational provision establishing a specific administrative register and its basic functions within the wider framework — it is more concrete than a structural rule because it creates an institutional mechanism and assigns its core uses. Its abstraction level is low-to-intermediate: it does not lay down a general principle, but rather specifies who is recorded, what evidentiary value certain entries have, and how the information is made available.", "Operational provision at a low-to-mid level of abstraction: it does not set a general principle for the whole framework, but regulates a specific procedural mechanism within a defined decision process. Its structure is technical because it fixes the conditions for use, the required contents of notices, the sequence of steps, and the closing and award rules, leaving little room for further normative interpretation.", "Operational provision with a moderately technical character: it sets out the concrete conditions under which a specific contractual arrangement may be used, together with the associated procedural and qualification requirements. Its abstraction level is low because it does not state a general principle or institutional design, but instead fixes detailed rules, sequencing, and implementation constraints for a particular case.", "Operational provision at a relatively specific level: it regulates the composition of a decision-making body only in the particular case where a contract is awarded under a specific selection criterion. Its normative role is technical and implementation-oriented, because it does not set a general principle but instead authorizes participation by a named official within a narrowly defined procedural context.", "Operational provision with a narrow, concrete application rule: it prescribes a specific mechanism to be used only in a defined procedural scenario, and it also sets a numerical trigger and an express exception. Its structure is technical rather than foundational because it does not articulate a general principle or allocate broad powers, but instead fixes the operative conditions and method-selection steps for implementation.", "Operational provision at a relatively low level of abstraction: it does not set out a general principle for the whole code, but regulates a specific contracting mechanism through concrete conditions and procedural steps. Its structure is technical because it fixes duration limits, admissibility constraints, and the exact sequence for selecting and awarding subsequent contracts."]

layer_description: These provisions do not create autonomous substantive rules; they direct the interpreter to other norms, instruments, or rule-sets that govern a given case. Normatively, they function as linkage or gap-filling clauses within the hierarchy, specifying the applicable legal regime and delimiting how external or pre-existing rules are to be used in the code.
repr_descriptions: ["Structural cross-reference clause that integrates external legal regimes by default, operating as a gap-filling rule rather than a self-contained substantive standard. It sits below foundational provisions and above technical rules because it does not create a new procedure itself, but determines which existing bodies of rules apply when the code is silent.", "Operational cross-reference clause that channels the reader to a pre-existing set of rules and limits their application by reference to another provision and an external statutory regime. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not establish a general principle or autonomous procedure, but instead specifies the exact rule-set governing a defined case.", "Structural cross-reference clause that integrates external legal sources into the code by default, operating as a gap-filling rule rather than a self-contained substantive norm. It sits below foundational provisions and above detailed procedures because it does not create a new rule, but directs which existing regimes apply where the code is silent.", "This is an operational cross-reference clause, sitting low on the abstraction scale because it does not state a general principle but identifies which existing provisions apply in a defined procedural setting. Its detailed carve-outs and minimum time limits show that it functions as a technical rule-setter, adjusting the general regime through specific exceptions and procedural parameters.", "Operational cross-reference clause that channels a specific category of cases to an existing set of provisions, rather than laying down a general principle. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it mainly identifies the applicable rule set and carves out a limited reservation, without creating a new autonomous standard.", "Highly technical cross-reference clause identifying a specific external instrument to be taken into account within a conflict-of-rules provision. It sits at the operational end of the spectrum because it does not state a general principle or procedure, but merely points to one concrete legal source for application in a defined context.", "Highly specific technical cross-reference clause, operating at the lowest end of abstraction. It merely identifies one external instrument by citation, functioning as a definitional or referential element within a broader list rather than establishing any general principle, power, or procedure.", "Highly operational and technical cross-reference clause, because it begins a specific rule by tying it to a defined subset of providers rather than stating a general principle. Its function is to delimit the scope of a later obligation within a particular procedural context, making it a narrow implementation detail rather than a structural norm.", "Operational cross-reference clause that points to a specific evaluative sub-rule within a broader assessment framework. It sits near the technical end of the spectrum because it does not itself set the criterion, but merely identifies one particular category of requirements to be examined under an existing procedure.", "Highly specific cross-reference clause at the operational end of the hierarchy: it does not lay down a general rule itself, but points to one particular sub-rule within a broader provision. Its function is purely technical, identifying a discrete item to be applied in a defined context rather than establishing a principle or procedure."]

layer_description: These provisions operate at the lowest hierarchical level, making targeted textual changes, substitutions, exclusions, cross-reference updates, or other micro-corrections to existing articles. They do not create independent general rules or structures, but fine-tune the wording and mechanics of a pre-existing legal framework.
repr_descriptions: ["This is a structural and transitional provision, sitting below foundational principles but above purely technical implementation details. Its main function is to coordinate the entry of the code into the existing legal order by extending applicability, amending other texts, and directing institutional adaptation, rather than laying down a standalone operative rule.", "Highly technical and operational amendment clause, sitting at the lowest end of the abstraction spectrum because it makes a single textual correction to an existing provision. It does not establish a general rule or procedure; it merely fine-tunes the wording of one specific paragraph within the prior act.", "Highly technical amending provision at the operational end of the hierarchy: it makes targeted textual substitutions and inserts a narrow exclusion clause within an existing article. Its function is purely corrective and specific, without setting any general principle or broader structural rule.", "Highly operational and technical amendment clause: it makes a targeted textual change to a specific existing article, rather than laying down a general principle or structural rule. Its function is purely corrective and micro-normative, operating at the level of precise legislative drafting within a pre-existing framework.", "Operational to technical amendment clause: it does not set a general principle, but modifies specific wording, deadlines, and procedural steps within an existing provision. Its function is highly targeted and implementation-oriented, refining a pre-existing rule by adjusting detailed conditions and procedural mechanics.", "Highly operational and technical amendment clause: it does not lay down a general principle, but rewrites specific wording, inserts precise conditions, and adjusts cross-references within an existing provision. Its place in the hierarchy is therefore low on the abstraction scale, because it fine-tunes the mechanics of application, publication, and procedural coordination rather than establishing a new structural rule.", "Highly technical and operational amendment clause, sitting near the bottom of the hierarchy because it makes targeted textual substitutions and insertions into an existing provision. Its function is not to state a general principle or create a new framework, but to fine-tune specific wording and cross-references within a defined article.", "Highly operational and technical: this is an amending clause that makes targeted textual substitutions and insertions into existing provisions, rather than stating any general principle or autonomous rule. Its normative role is confined to fine-tuning specific wording, adding a narrow exception, and adjusting the scope of application within a pre-existing framework.", "Operational-to-technical amendment clause that rewrites a specific qualification rule and its evidentiary mechanics within an existing provision. It sits low on the abstraction spectrum because it does not set a general principle or institutional framework, but instead adjusts the concrete conditions under which a defined category may rely on particular requirements, with further detail left to implementing guidelines.", "Highly technical amending clause operating at the lowest level of abstraction: it does not lay down a general principle or structure, but makes targeted textual substitutions in existing provisions. Its function is purely operational, adjusting specific wording and cross-references within a pre-existing rule rather than creating an autonomous norm."]
